doc: Canonical Companion species roster — the single source of truth every species-bearing surface is drift-tested against (CHO-2037). status=hero: rollable + Path-seeded + art-shipped starter species. status=legacy: retired pre-CHO-2032 gacha breeds kept ONLY so already-emitted events stay decodable — never rollable, never re-seeded. wire_value is the CompanionSpecies proto enum number: NEVER reuse or renumber; new species take the next free value. To onboard species N+1 follow docs/references/companion-species-onboarding.md — the drift guards in chora-consumption, chora-tenancy, chora-contracts/gen/go/contracttest and chora-web go RED on any surface you miss.
